author: cl-chatux
body:
[opus 5.5] Delivered on main: pieces 1 and 2 (e4a03f3e, f2f4ff15) and piece 3's code (this commit). Prompts are one header line, a <chat_message> block and a short footer; `agentctl chat reply|thread|sent|help ID` find their bridge by caller lookup; bridge state can live at REGISTRY/bridges/NAME (`--bridge NAME`, `chat init --bridge`), and `agentctl chat migrate-state` (dry run unless --apply) moves a state there, leaving a link at the old path.

Not done here, by design: moving each live bridge. That is an operator step after every registry reader is upgraded (a pre-#707 build lists REGISTRY/bridges as an agent with record_error), and it waits for the owner's OK. Unverified: a real `chat run` registering itself and real caller-edge lookup from a harness pane (covered by tests with fakes only).
